artifacts.name: Hot-spots & cold-spots
artifacts.summary: Global Moran’s I = -0.06. 2 hot-spot and 0 cold-spot neighbourhood(s) of vegetarian & vegan eateries density (local Moran’s I / LISA). Only 10 sub-areas: too few for the permutation test to establish significance, so read a grey map as "not enough units to tell", not as "no clustering". Use a finer `subarea_mode` or a larger area to make this map informative. Results depend on OpenStreetMap data completeness. If you can, contribute to OSM.
artifacts.description:
Sub-areas classified by the local Moran’s I statistic (LISA) over vegetarian & vegan eateries density: **High-High** = a dense neighbourhood surrounded by others like it (hot-spot); **Low-Low** = a sparse one among others like it (cold-spot); **High-Low / Low-High** = spatial outliers. Significance uses a deterministic permutation test; non-significant sub-areas are greyed out.

Provenance: OpenStreetMap data as of 2026-06-19 · indicator: veg_restaurants · reachability: straight-line distance.

A populous sub-area with average density can still read as under-served here. Sub-areas without usable population data are omitted.

artifacts.name: Availability on a Sunday afternoon
artifacts.summary: Opening hours are well mapped here (86% of managed venues). 91 vegetarian & vegan eateries are known to be open on a Sunday afternoon. "Not specified" mostly covers freely accessible open-air places carrying no opening hours.
artifacts.description:
Features classified by whether their OpenStreetMap opening_hours indicate they are open at a fixed reference time (a Sunday afternoon). Managed venues such as libraries and museums may be closed then; open-air places usually carry no opening hours and are counted as "not specified". This indicator is only shown where enough venues carry opening hours to be meaningful.

Provenance: OpenStreetMap data as of 2026-06-19 · indicator: veg_restaurants · reachability: straight-line distance.
